editorial:
Imagine you and your friends heading back to a creepy, old summer camp to get it ready for the season. That is exactly what happens here, but instead of s'mores and campfire stories, you get a giant, angry Sasquatch. The vibe is total classic slasher energy, where a group of young counselors accidentally wake up a monster because someone messed with a sacred totem pole years ago. You will feel the tension build as they realize they are being hunted in the woods, turning their dream summer job into a fight for their lives.

What really works here is how the movie keeps the action moving quickly. The creature effects are fun, and the kills are creative enough to keep you on the edge of your seat. While some of the acting feels a bit like a B-movie, it actually adds to the charm. If you love creature features, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the lone survivor has to use every bit of strength to fight off the beast. After most of the group is killed, the survivor manages to outsmart the Sasquatch in a desperate last stand. The movie wraps up with the monster finally being defeated, though it leaves you wondering if other creatures are still lurking in the woods. It ends with a sense of relief but a warning about respecting nature.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big monsters and campy horror movies.
